maintenance_led.reason: Title insurance and escrow revenue is tied to new real estate transactions (purchases, refinances), not servicing installed assets.

publicly_funded.reason: Title insurance premiums and escrow fees are paid by home buyers, sellers, lenders and commercial real estate parties.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through title insurance underwriting and agency operations; acquisitions (e.g., NotaryCam) are occasional, not the main growth driver.

mission_critical.reason: Title insurance and settlement services are transaction-based; agents and lenders can choose other title underwriters or agents per deal.

notes: Mission-critical is a judgement call: title insurance is required for most mortgages but customers can switch providers per transaction.
